summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of TriCord Presence Installer web page. All backend API endpoints and frontend UI features are working perfectly. The app successfully serves the .cia file with correct metadata, displays a scannable QR code for FBI remote install, and provides all required file information and download options.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/installer/info returns correct JSON (filename, title, version=2, size=1688512, sha256, download_path)
Backend: GET /api/download/tricord-presence-installer.cia returns 200, Content-Type application/octet-stream, Content-Length 1688512, body 1688512 bytes with correct SHA-256
Backend: HEAD /api/download/tricord-presence-installer.cia returns 200 with correct Content-Length
Frontend: QR code canvas renders inside [data-testid=qr-frame]
Frontend: Download URL displayed correctly in [data-testid=download-url] (matches REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + /api/download/tricord-presence-installer.cia)
Frontend: File size 1.61 Mo displayed in [data-testid=info-size]
Frontend: Copy URL button [data-testid=copy-url-btn] is present, clickable, and functional
Frontend: Copy SHA button [data-testid=copy-sha-btn] is present, clickable, and functional
Frontend: Manual download link [data-testid=manual-download-btn] points to correct download URL
Frontend: No error messages found on page
